goal: A Python CLI tool that scans a specified directory for image files (PNG, JPG) and PDF files. It uses a local OCR library (like pytesseract) to extract text, then applies regex rules to identify vendor, date, and amount fields. It outputs a structured CSV/JSON file and supports simple tax categorization rules.
acceptance_criteria: The module scans a directory recursively for image and PDF files.
The module mocks pytesseract to extract text and applies regex to find vendor, date, and amount.
The module outputs a structured CSV/JSON file based on extracted data.
